title: TalKIA_LLM_Step_Contract
description: Deterministic contract for hybrid Bayesian + LLM candidate word generation in caa-open-engine

suggested_topic.description: Contextual label for the current communicative intent or open conversation branch.

conversation_mode.description: Active dialogue sub-mode; dynamic when trigger_type is 'conversacion'.

candidate_words.description: Exact array of 10 candidate words ranked by P(W_n | Trigger, Intent, HourBucket, W_1..n-1).

constructed_sentence.description: Natural first-person singular sentence ready for Text-to-Speech (TTS) output.

confidence_score.description: Hybrid confidence weight between empirical SQLite prior and contextual LLM inference.
